header.intro:
I work with a select number of properties at any given time — representing sellers and buyers across Portland and the Willamette Valley. Below you'll find what's currently active and a sample of what I've recently closed.

For details on any closed transaction, reach out directly. I'm happy to share context on comparable sales in your market.

activeSection.headline: Currently available.
activeSection.note: Click any listing to expand full property details, unit mix, and financials.

offMarket.headline: Looking to buy? I frequently work with properties that never hit the open market.
offMarket.body: Many of the properties I represent are sold quietly — before they're ever publicly listed. If you're a qualified buyer looking for multifamily in Portland or the Willamette Valley, let's talk about what I'm seeing and what may be coming available.

closedSection.headline:
A sample of what I've sold
in the last 12 months.

seller.headlineHtml:
You don't need to be ready
to list to start a conversation.
seller.body: Most of my best engagements start years before a sale. Let's talk about your property, your timeline, and what the market looks like right now.

buyer.headline: Looking for multifamily in Portland or the Valley?
buyer.body: I work with a select number of qualified buyers and can often connect them with properties before they hit the market. Let's talk about what you're looking for.
